tasks.title: Move a picnic and apologise clearly: read and notice
tasks.objective: Use parce que for a reason and mais for a contrasting constraint. À partir de sets an earliest time; it does not change everyone’s arrangement.
tasks.context: Léa a invité trois amis à un pique-nique samedi à midi. La météo annonce de fortes pluies. Elle propose de se retrouver chez elle à treize heures, sans changer le jour. Hugo répond qu’il peut venir, mais seulement à partir de quatorze heures. Léa lui dit de les rejoindre plus tard : les autres commenceront à treize heures. Elle s’excuse pour ce changement et demande à chacun de confirmer. Son message ne dit pas que le pique-nique est reporté au dimanche.

tasks.title: Move a picnic and apologise clearly: transfer and assess
tasks.objective: Transfer the module language to an unfamiliar situation and review comprehension, writing and interaction separately.
tasks.context:
Write 80–110 French words inviting an imaginary friend, changing one detail because of a practical problem and apologising. Keep the date and times consistent. Role-play a reply from a friend who can arrive late, and confirm what changes for that friend only.

Revision: retrieve the three contextual expressions without the model on a later day; correct saved errors and reuse them in a new scenario.

Review task fulfilment, source fidelity, grammar, vocabulary, organisation and interaction/repair separately. Treat spelling extraction as supported practice, not proficiency evidence.
